paragraphs: Chapter 802
Episode 198. Unexpected Bargain (2)
Tikan.
Jin received a call from the Sword Garden and immediately came here. The meeting on the Red Name Tribe incident had just finished, not even a day ago.
"Long time no see, Vice Commander Vishukel."
As Jin got off the Red Owl and offered a handshake, Vishukel grabbed his hand with an expressionless face. Jin didn't miss the tension hidden beneath his expression.

"By the way, what brings you here all of a sudden? Last time... it must have been about a month. At that time, our alliance expressed the desire to meet Orgal, but you didn't come to respond until now, did you?"
-'We need to meet Orgal, Your Majesty. He will surely know Sanna. If we go directly like last time, it will cause a commotion, so please send a letter immediately.'
Right after meeting Sanna at the Tower of Stories, the Barmel Alliance had requested a meeting with Kinselo. It was to dig up information about Sanna.
However, Kinselo did not respond, and in the meantime, Ameris woke up, Orgal and Jephrin fell into a coma, and they were attacked by the Red Name Tribe.
From the beginning, Jin pointed out this fact and made Vishukel and the executives of Kinselo uncomfortable.
"Vice Commander Jin, we were unable to respond immediately to that issue because our leader was busy. I, as the deputy commander, will apologize on his behalf."
"Aha, then, you, Vice Commander Vishukel, are here not to answer my letter but to discuss a different problem, right?"
"......That's right."

"To rephrase it, you guys ignored the meeting request of the Runkandel Sogaju and the leader of the Barmel Alliance just because you were busy, but now you urgently need to make an apology to me for something I don't know, so you shamelessly came to visit without notice. Is that correct?"
Vishukel kept his expression, cursing inside. There was not a single wrong word in Jin's sarcastic voice.
"......I believe there's nothing to say even if you think that way. I will take responsibility for the rudeness in any way."
Jin looked at Vishukel for a moment and organized his thoughts.
'It seems the situation in Kinselo is not very good. There must be problems with Orgal and Jephrin, and it won't be just because of the Red Name Tribe.'
Kinselo was coming out much lower than Jin expected.
"I will take responsibility no matter what... What would you do if I demanded Bubar's head?"
"That pig bastard, no. I can't offer his head, but I would be willing to offer my own arms."
"We can't do that, brother!"
Marjiella called out to Vishukel in an exaggerated voice. Seeing her take out a handkerchief to wipe her dry eyes, Jin chuckled to himself.
"Don't take it too seriously, it was just a figure of speech. I'm not from the Red Name Tribe, what would I do with a human's head or arm."
At the mention of the Red Name Tribe, Vishukel's forehead furrowed.
"As for the compensation for rudeness, it's fine. I also went to Kinselo's headquarters on a whim and almost settled things with Orgal, let's just call it even."
"Thank you for understanding."

"However, I would appreciate if we can have a very honest and open conversation today. Just like you were willing to offer your arms just now, if you show sincerity, I will listen generously and positively. But if you try to calculate or manipulate things because you don't want to lose more, Kinselo will leave today with nothing but losses."
Vishukel nodded heavily.
Looking back, Kinselo has always been on the losing end when dealing with Jin, but today was particularly unfair.
"I will be careful."
"Good. I've kept you standing too long, there's a nice spot in the garden where we can have tea and chat."

As they sat at the garden table, cookies and refreshments were served. Ainas immediately started sneaking cookies to give to Bubar into her bosom, and seeing her, Vishukel had to suppress his bubbling anger. It was a small mercy that Bubar hadn't come in a group.
"Now, I'm curious why it is you here instead of Orgal or Jephrin."
"The two of them are currently in a coma."
Just as Jin warned, Vishukel obediently told the truth.
"......In a coma?"
"It's been about ten days. It happened suddenly without any warning."

Upon hearing this, Jin immediately thought it coincided with the time Ameris woke up. When he asked for the exact date, it matched exactly with when the two lost consciousness and when Ameris woke up.
'It seems to be related to Lord Ameris... Why? Lord Ameris said he doesn't know the two. When Kinselo returns, I should ask if they have any ideas.'
With Orgal and Jephrin unconscious, it wasn't possible to confirm immediately whether they knew Ameris. Jin shook his head with a regretful expression.
"I thought you were a bit tougher after meeting with Veil last time, but it seems Orgal is still not doing well. Do you see any signs of recovery?"
"The devils have examined him and say there's some hope. They also said it was due to psychological shock, not a physical problem."

"I see. I understand why Orgal and Jephrin could not step in despite the fact that the earth of the beastmen was devastated. Oh, you must be wondering how we know about it. We sent Lord Yona to watch over. And we met those guys before Kinselo did."
"……What on earth are they? To be honest, I thought they might have something to do with the current situation. But their ways are quite different from ours."
"That's correct. The Red Name Tribe is neither part of the Barmel Alliance, Run Kandel, nor my brothers. They are an ancient combat tribe that woke up by chance."
"Woke up by chance, an ancient combat tribe?"
"It seems that Kinzelo has no information at all about the Red Name Tribe. The Red Name Tribe resides in a similar domain as the demons."
"What on earth……."
Jin pointed to the ground with his finger.
"Underground. The Red Name Tribe resides underground. Surely you won't tell me you didn't know that the demons live underground?"
Vischel concealed his surprise.

There was no clue as to how Jin knew that the gate to the demon world was underground. Kinzelo didn't know about Jin and Shino's encounter, nor did they know exactly what happened in the Tower of Talk.

"I'll leave it to your imagination as to how I happened to encounter the Red Name Tribe first and why I ended up killing their leaders. But I hope you don't think that the Red Name Tribe started its activities because of me and that Kinzelo suffered because of them. It was your side that has been messing with the underground for a long time."
Vischel couldn't respond and waited for the next words.
"From what I heard, it is assumed that you, Vischel, are the one in Kinzelo who opens the gate to the demon world."
As soon as he heard those words, Vischel recalled what Octavia had said in the Sota Desert.
- A demon.... Could it be, you opened the gate? This was your ability, Vischel Eblano!
‘The guardian at the time, Hedo, was a core executive of Zipple...... After moving to the Barmel Alliance, did she tell Jin about the information she heard from Octavia?’

Whether then or now, the misconception that Vischel was a power associated with the gate to the demon world was a pure misunderstanding. It was finally a chance for Vischel to clear this misunderstanding.

"I have no abilities related to the gate to the demon world. The information you heard was probably a misunderstanding by Octavia Zipple. All matters related to the demon world are solely in the hands of our leader."
"What about Mariella?"
"My sister is the same."
"Yuria."
As soon as Yuria confirmed the truth with her ability, a blue thread came out.
"Then how does Orgal bring the demons from the demon world?"
The omitted content in that question was how to bypass the entrance to the 'underground world guarded by Ameris'.
Vischel couldn't grasp the omitted content. Because he had no information about Ameris at all.
"I haven't told you yet what I want to ask of you. If you're going to request information about the demon world, I think it's best to hear the request first."
"Go ahead."
"Share all the information you know about the Red Name Tribe with us."
"I can't share all the information. Instead, I can share all the information that appears in the record magic that I have permission to cast within the territory of Kinzelo."
"And deal with the Red Name Tribe until our leader wakes up."

"Based on what you're saying now, one could interpret that our Kinzelo is powerless, and therefore the Barmel Alliance would be ruined if it was to face the Red Name Tribe. You're making quite a risky statement. Is Kinzelo unable to handle even a part of the Red Name Tribe?"

"It's only to stop the slaughter of the beast-people. We're not helpless because of the demons, but we are lacking mobility now that our leader is absent. According to our investigation, they use spatial movement. As you know, the beast-people can't resist them."
"True, even Berract and Badrei were terrified. For the beast-people, the Red Name Tribe is nothing short of a natural enemy."
"Will you agree to the proposal?"
"It doesn't seem like a bad condition, since we'll learn about the Red Name Tribe while helping Kinzelo. If we agree, we could also learn how Orgal is using the demon world."
Jin pretended to ponder for a moment before nodding.

In fact, from Jin's point of view, it was a trade where he had nothing to lose. Anyway, the Red Name Tribe would be hunting beast-people for the time being, and he needed Kinzelo's permission to cast record magic in that area.
Even if he refused to help, Jin did not think Kinzelo would truly fail to stop the Red Name Tribe. As Vischel said, it would only result in serious losses to the beast-people forces.

Above all, Jin was wary of the possibility that the Red Name Tribe could become allies with Kinzelo. Just like the sects of the Sun God Religion, they all wanted the resurrection of the Sun God, regardless of their different doctrines.
"Alright. But I want to add one last condition."
"Go ahead."
Jin grinned and pointed at Ainas with his eyes.
"I would appreciate it if Ainas Caligo paid for the cookies he took."
"Wha, was I supposed to pay for these!?"
Ainas looked at Jin in surprise.
"......How should I calculate?"
"Kinzelo rejected my steel trade last time...... even though I was willing to pay several times the market price as a premium. In the end, we sold that steel to Zipple, not us."
He was saying that he wanted the steel from the deal that had failed back then in exchange for the cookies.
Vischel had no choice but to grit his teeth and nod.
